messages.subject: Question regarding R on Hadoop
parts:

I am very new to R.

I have EC2 Cloudera hadoop cluster up and running. I want to install RHadoop on my hadoop cluster.

Please provide me some step by step instruction.

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Question regarding R on Hadoop
parts:
https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RHadoop/wiki/Downloads and scroll to the bottom. Googling RHadoop installation would have also helped. If you are very new to R, you will probably find RHadoop a little bit of a hurdle. Why not learn R first, and then move on to Rhadoop? It's like learning to drive. You could start with an F1 car or a Toyota Corolla. The chances of completing the training are quite different.


Antonio
